g.text: Poroelastic crack: which reference values each run matched
One row per run, one cell per requested quantity; filled = within 1% of the corrected key.
Only runs that took the tip to be drained (GPT, Opus) matched K₁(0⁺); A also needs the tip term;
K₂(∞) and V₂(∞) need the confined back-stress. Original round: 50-minute budget; added trials had none.
